sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: XENTRA collects necessary information to provide our skill-based prediction services:
items: Phone Number: Used for account identification and security.
Display Name: To identify you on leaderboards.
Device Information: To ensure platform integrity and prevent fraud.
Transaction History: Keeping track of your wallet activities.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
sections.content: Your data is used specifically for:
items: Authenticating and securing your account.
Processing wallet deposits and withdrawals.
Calculating and displaying contest rankings.
Improving app features and user experience.

sections.title: 3. Data Security
sections.content: We use industry-standard encryption and security protocols to protect your information. Your phone number is never shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: 4. User Rights & Account Deletion
sections.content: You have full control over your data. You can request a summary of the data we hold or request its permanent removal.
sections.deletionNote: Please note: Account deletion is permanent and will result in the loss of all wallet balances and history.

sections.title: 5. Compliance
sections.content: XENTRA complies with applicable data protection regulations. We do not participate in unauthorized data sharing or selling.

sections.title: 6. Children's Privacy
sections.content: XENTRA is intended for users who are 18 years of age or older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under the age of 18. If we become aware that a user is under 18, we will take steps to remove their information and terminate their account.

sections.title: 7. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions regarding your privacy, please contact our support team:

sections.title: 1. Eligibility
items: You must be 18 years or older to use XENTRA.
By registering, you confirm you meet the legal age.

sections.title: 2. Account Registration
items: Registration is completed using your phone number.
You are responsible for keeping your login information secure.
Each person is allowed only one account.
XENTRA reserves the right to suspend or close accounts involved in fraud, abuse, or suspicious activity.

sections.title: 3. Nature of the Platform
items: XENTRA is a skill-based sports prediction platform operated by Xentra Sports.
Participants compete against other players by predicting match outcomes as exact scores.
Contest rankings are determined based on prediction accuracy and performance.
Contest outcomes depend on participant skill, knowledge, and analysis of sporting events.
All contests are entertainment-based competitions designed for sports fans.
XENTRA does not provide betting odds and is not a sportsbook.

sections.title: 4. Wallet & Payments
items: A platform service fee is deducted from contest entry fees.
The remaining amount forms the contest prize pool that is distributed to qualifying winners.

sections.title: 5. Platform Fees
items: A service fee is deducted before distributing prizes.
The remaining amount forms the prize pool.

sections.title: 6. Winners & Rankings
sections.content: XENTRA is committed to maintaining a fair and competitive environment for all participants. Users must participate honestly and respect the integrity of the platform and its contests.

sections.title: 7. Fair Play
sections.content: Any attempt to manipulate results or abuse the system may result in:

sections.title: 8. No Profit Guarantee
items: Participation in contests involves risk and does not guarantee winnings.
Prizes are awarded only to top-ranked participants based on contest results.
XENTRA does not guarantee profits or financial gains from participation.

sections.title: 9. Service Availability
sections.content: XENTRA may modify or suspend services at any time.

sections.title: 10. Withdrawal Processing
items: Withdrawal requests are subject to review and verification by the platform.
XENTRA processes withdrawal requests within 24 to 48 hours after approval.
In certain cases, additional verification may be required before withdrawals are completed.
XENTRA reserves the right to delay or refuse withdrawals if suspicious or fraudulent activity is detected.

sections.title: 11. Changes to Conditions
sections.content: These conditions may change at any time. Continued use of the app indicates acceptance of changes.

sections.title: 12. Contact
sections.content: For assistance, contact XENTRA through the app or email support@xentrasports.com.
